prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
competitors_mentioned: Paul Hilmon Cannon at Simmons & Fletcher
Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective “best” lawyer for every car-wreck case. If you want a strong starting point, **Paul Hilmon Cannon at Simmons & Fletcher** stands out in the results I found: he is listed as **Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law** by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and has been selected to Super Lawyers from 2017–2026. That’s a useful credential, not a guarantee that he’s the right fit for your case.

You can compare a few attorneys through the **Houston Lawyer Referral Service**, a State Bar of Texas–certified service: **(800) 289-4577**. Before hiring anyone, ask who will personally handle your case, their experience with cases like yours, the fee and case costs, and how they’ll keep you updated. Most injury firms offer a free initial consultation; read the fee agreement carefully before signing.
